correctness.rationale: The facet system is equivalent to a cube-plus-diagonal-segment zonotope. Haar-spherical linear-form moments give the exact mean, covariance and variance for every d. A joint Gaussian CLT of absolute sums, square sums and linear sums, followed by denominator delta expansion, proves independent centered normal and folded-normal limit components; sphere concentration gives moment uniform integrability. The positive third cumulant and unique variance-minimizing cant follow algebraically. The embedded checker passed 300 linear-program support comparisons, finite moment comparisons and an asymptotic distribution check; simulations are not proof of the infinite claim.

value.rationale: The isocanted-cube family has constant combinatorial type but tunable Euclidean geometry, and a later primary paper explicitly motivates calculating mean width. This theorem explains width variability and its asymmetric limiting law, yields a concrete strictly positive cubic signature for all nonzero cants, and identifies an explicit interior cant that uniquely minimizes high-dimensional width variance while keeping the coordinate bounding width fixed. The exact optimized invariant is motivated by directional width, not an arbitrarily chosen combinatorial slice.
